candidats.titre: File:US Navy 051015-N-2984R-009 Squadron plane captains hold tie down chains used to tie down aircraft on their shoulders during flight operations.jpg
candidats.description: Atlantic Ocean (Oct. 15, 2005) – Squadron plane captains hold tie down chains used to tie down aircraft on their shoulders during flight operations aboard the Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Harry S. Truman (CVN 75). Truman is currently conducting carrier qualifications and sustainment training with embarked Carrier Air Wing Three (CVW-3) off the East Coast. U.S. Navy photo by Photographer's Mate Airman Ricardo J. Reyes (RELEASED)
